title: RDMSim: An Exemplar for Evaluation and Comparison of Decision-Making Techniques for Self-Adaptation
reasoning: The paper presents a technical exemplar for evaluating decision-making techniques in self-adaptive systems, specifically for Remote Data Mirroring. The evaluation criteria are technical, such as cost, performance, and reliability. There is no content related to benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
